snippet.title: Angry Henry And The Escape From The Helicopter Lords: Part 17: The Re-Reckoning (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Angry Henry And The Escape From The Helicopter Lords: Part 17: The Re-Reckoning is a videogame in the "Helicopter Murder Simulation" genre.

FREE on iOS now: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/angry-henry-escape-from-helicopter/id878249839?mt=8

Android version coming soon!

Website: http://angryhenryandtheescapefromthehelicopterlordspart17.com/

Soundtrack: https://franciscocerda.bandcamp.com/album/angry-henry-ost

AHatEftHL:XVII:tRR is an infinite-runner-and-infinite-shooter-and-sometimes-screamer game, made for smartphone and tablet devices.

This videogame is a two-button action platformer. With your left thumb, you will make Angry Henry jump, scream, and float gently to the ground. With your right thumb, you will aim Henry's gun. The three guns in this videogame (the Uzi, the Laser Shotgun, and the Chainsaw Cannon) each have a unique control scheme.

This videogame is thumbbleedingly difficult. 

This is the first videogame to provide the experience of killing God by charging up a gigantic chainsaw and firing it into His face.

This videogame's chiptune soundtrack was described as "transcendently wonderful" by this sentence.

We would like to stress that this is a videogame.
